chapter_title: Concerning the Twelve Signs of the Zodiac and the
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
 of

 Chapter


---


**
¶2.
** Whether the twelve ruling falsities that
 are established in the outermost natural
 mind, or the five chief evil aff
ections that circulate among them — all
 of these are governing powers according to their
 evil nature. They are all in mutual
 hostility and contradiction; each opposes
 the others, each threatens and undermines
 the rest. They strip
 one another of their stolen power through the
 operation of Divine Providence, which has arranged
 all the degrees of the mind according to
 order. Providence has gathered these evils
 and bound them within the revolving circuit
 of the natural mind, which turns ce
aselessly through its changing
 states. And as it turns and over
turns them, they exercise their evil
 influence in both higher and lower things,
 in the interior and exterior of life,
 according to the nature of their desire.
 Nevertheless, the law of divine order pres
ides over them, and the justice of
 heaven stands above them — compelling, ex
acting, and reclaiming from them
 whatever good and truth they hold captive
.

**¶3.**
 This is rightly understood as follows.
 The twelve ruling falsities were extracted from
 the five genera of evil and bound within
 the natural mind. Two were taken from
 each genus. The falsities of double
-mindedness and of far-f
lung persuasion belong to the genus
 of obscured understanding —
 which
 is confused thought dark
ened as
 by
 smoke. In contrast, the falsities
 of aggressive self-assertion and of dom
ineering pride belong to the genus of
 self-love. The falsities of
 stubborn resistance, of false equilibrium
 in
 judgment, and of counterfeit truth
 freely dispensed belong to the genus of
 empty reasoning. The falsities of poss
essive enclosure, of simulated innoc
ence, and of deep sensual obsc
urity belong to the genus of corrupted
 desire. The falsities of climbing amb
ition and of hidden malice belong to
 the genus of pure evil — the 
utter absence of spiritual light. These are
 the twelve ruling falsities of the de
praved natural mind, through which all
 wickedness ce
ase
lessly operates. For they are the source
 of all evil and corruption in the mind
, whether in perception or in the will
.

**¶4.**
 Understand also concerning the five chief evil
 affections — from what genus of
 evil each was formed. The evil aff
ection that simulates benevolence and
 wisdom was generated from the genus of obsc
ured understanding — that is, confused thought
. In contrast, the evil affection
 that simulates love and delight arose
 from the genus of self-love.
 The evil affection of cont
ention and aggression belongs to the genus
 of empty reasoning. The evil affection
 of cunning and subtle deception belongs
 to the genus of corrupted desire.
 And the evil affection of cold,
 obstinate malice belongs to the genus
 of pure evil.

**¶
5.** And also: the two
 fundamental evils are reckoned as
 self-love and worldly desire —
 the bar
ren and the craving. These are
 the father and the mother of all the
 fals
ities and evil affections just
 named.

**¶6.
** And also: Divine Good and Divine
 Truth, which are reckoned alongside
 these powers in the mind's accounting —
 though why are they reckoned together
 with them? — so that they may
 reign over them. You
 will discover
 that they subjugate the evils
 at every moment.

**¶
7.** These seven — the five
 chief evil affections and the two fundamental
 evils — are
 the agents of wickedness that accomplish every
 corrupt and destructive act in
 every province of the mind, throughout
 its whole
 extent, in higher things and in lower
, in every living affection, in
 the corrupt will and in
 the perverted understanding, in perception and
 in the voluntary life.

**
¶8.** Further I
 reveal concerning the twelve ruling falsities:
 they are distributed and appointed to
 four quarters of the natural mind, three
 to each quarter in these four regions,
 and they are established upon the revolving
 circuit of mental states. The falsities
 of aggressive self-assertion, domine
ering pride, and far-flung
 persuasion — these three belong to
 one quarter. In contrast, the fals
ities of stubborn resistance, climbing amb
ition, and simulated innocence —
 these three belong to another quarter. The
 falsities of double-mindedness,
 false equilibrium, and counterfeit
 truth freely dispensed belong to a third
 quarter. And the falsities of hidden
 malice, deep sensual obscurity
, and possessive enclosure belong to
 the fourth quarter. They are placed in
 this arrangement, appointed to these four regions
, and distributed throughout the natural mind.


**¶9.** When
 the quarter of aggressive self-assertion,
 domineering pride, and far-
flung persuasion is plun
dered by the divine order that presides
 over it — which exacts from it
, together with the leading evil affections
 that move within it — at that moment
 affl
iction strikes all the natural affections in
 the lower mind. However
, when the quarter of stubborn resistance
, simulated innocence, and climbing
 ambition is plundered, affl
iction at once befalls the natural per
ceptions, together with the knowledges
 and all the works of understanding. Yet
 again, when the quarter of hidden mal
ice, deep sensual obscurity,
 and possessive enclosure is plun
dered, scarcity befalls the
 truths present
 in the natural mind, and spiritual drought
 spreads from region to region.
 Conversely, when the quarter of double
-mindedness, false equilibrium,
 and counterfeit truth is plun
dered, deformity and stunting
 befall the rational human form from region
 to region.

**¶10
.** Behold, I have
 set forth concerning the twelve ruling falsities
: they were formed from the five genera
 of evil and confined within the natural mind
.

**¶11.**
 Also, I have taught concerning the other
 five, the chief evil affections:
 they too arose from the five genera of
 evil in the realm of spiritual darkness.


**¶12.** I
 have recounted also concerning the two fundamental
 evils: they are set to the
 mystery of self-love and worldly
 desire. They are the barren and
 the craving, the father and the
 mother of all evils.

**
¶13.** Again, I
 have revealed concerning Divine Good and Divine Truth
: they are strangers to all
 these
 evils. Yet, because of the
 constraint of the divine arrangement — in that
 the mind receives illumination from them,
 and because they are present among the ev
ils to
 rec
laim what
 the
 ev
ils have seized
 — for this reason they are reck
oned alongside the evils in the accounting
 of the mind. For Divine Good and
 Divine Truth proceed from the Divine itself;
 they do not belong to the evil aff
ections or the ruling falsities.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Whether these twelve signs of the zodiac that are fixed on the sphere, or these five stars that circle upon them; those and these are rulers, all of them, according to their essence. They are all enemies and rivals to each other ⟨one oppresses another, they threaten each other⟩. They plunder one another by the action of the great craftsman who has formed all the worlds. He has gathered [them] and bound them on the sphere above, which circles constantly. Now, while it circles and tumbles them, so they shall do everything that they desire, above and below, according to their pleasure. Nevertheless, a guardian is over them, a debt-collector above them; compelling, extorting, and taking what is theirs away from them!

Now, this is how it can rightly be understood. They were [s]eized from the five worlds of Darkness, and bound on the sphere. Two zodiacal signs were taken per world. Gemini and Sagittarius belong to the world of smoke, which is the mind. In contrast, Aries and Leo belong to the world of fire. Taurus, Aquarius and Libra belong to the world of wind. Cancer and Virgo and [P]isces belong to the world of water. Capricorn and Scorpio belong to the world of Darkness. These are the twelve rulers of depravity, the ones that wicked[ness] shall not [cease from.] For they cause all the evil and [corruption in the wo]rld, whether in tree or in flesh.

And understand also about these five stars, the leaders: from where were they formed? The star of Zeus (Jupiter) was generated from the world of smoke, which is the mind. In contrast, Aphrodite (Venus) came about from the world of fire. And then Ares (Mars) belongs to the world of wind. Hermes (Mercury) belongs to the world of water. Cronos (Saturn) belongs to the world [of] Darkness.
And also, the two ascendants are counted to fire and desire, the dry and the moist. They are the father and the mother of all these.

And also, the sun and the moon, which are counted in with them as a rule ⟨[counte]d to their kind, but why did they count them in with them?⟩ so that they would reign over them. You will discover they subjugate them at every moment.

These seven we have named, the five stars and the two ascendants: They are the doers of wickedness that do every wicked and bad act in every land, the whole of it, above and below, in every creature, in the dry and the moist, in tree and flesh.

Once more I reveal to you about these signs of the zodiac: [They] are distributed, appointed on four sides, three per angle in these four places. And they are fixed to this revolving sphere. Aries, Leo and Sagittarius, they three belong to a single side. In contrast, Taurus, Capricorn and Virgo, these other three belong to another side. And then, Gemini, Libra and Aquarius belong to another side. Scorpio, Pisces and Cancer belong to another corner. Now, they are placed like this, appointed to these four parts, and distributed on the sphere.

So, when the side of Aries, Leo and Sagittarius will be plundered by the guardian who is over it, who extorts from it and the leaders who move upon it; at that instant shall affliction strike all the four-footed creatures below. However, when [the side] of Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn will be plundered; [affliction] shall at once befall the herbs, together with the vegetables and all the fruits of the trees. Yet again, when the side of Scorpio, Pisces and Cancer will be plundered; scarcity shall befall the waters upon the earth, and drought be from place to place. Conversely, should the side of Gemini, Libra and Aquarius be plundered; deformity and stuntedness shall befall the form of mankind from place to place.
Behold now, I have explained to you about these twelve signs of the zodiac: They were fashioned from the five worlds of Darkness, and bound on the sphere.
Also, I have taught you about the other five, the stars: They too came about from the five worlds of the land of Darkness.
I have recounted to you also about the [t]wo ascendants: They are set to the mystery of fire and desire. They are the dry and the moist, the father and the mother.

Again, I have revealed to you about the sun and the moon: They are strangers to them. Still, because of the constraint of the arrangement, in that the thing receives light, and as they belong and plunder them; because of this they were counted in with them in relation to the calculation of the number. For, the sun and the moon are from out of the greatness, not belonging to the stars and the signs of the zodiac.
